name: 49428 · Jenison, MI
findings: ZIP 49428 (Jenison) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49428 (Jenison) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
